title: GEISA Waveform v0.9.0
description: Canonical structure for a GEISA waveform stream descriptor and waveform subscribe/unsubscribe request-response messages.

waveformRequestType.description: Waveform request operation for an application instance.

waveformSampleType.description: Sample encoding used by the waveform stream.

streamId.description: Waveform stream identifier. If a platform supports waveform data, it SHALL expose the baseline interoperable stream identifier 'waveform-base'. Platforms MAY expose additional stream identifiers for alternate waveform views. Applications SHALL use waveform metadata to interpret a stream and SHALL NOT infer stream characteristics by parsing the stream-id value.

name.description: Optional platform-supplied display name for the waveform stream. This field is informational only and is intended for display, diagnostics, or logging. Applications SHALL NOT rely on this field for interoperability behavior.

description.description: Optional platform-supplied human-readable description of the waveform stream. This field is informational only and is intended for display, diagnostics, or logging. Applications SHALL NOT rely on this field for interoperability behavior.

voltage-channel-count.description: Number of voltage channels present in each sample time step.

current-channel-count.description: Number of current channels present in each sample time step.

other-channel-count.description: Number of additional non-voltage, non-current channels present in each sample time step, if any.

total-channel-count.description: Total number of channels present in each sample time step. This SHALL equal voltage-channel-count plus current-channel-count plus other-channel-count.

sample-rate-hz.description: Sampling rate in hertz for the waveform stream.

samples-per-cycle.description: Discrete sample count per nominal AC cycle, when applicable. For baseline waveform-base streams, this SHALL be at least 128 where AC cycle semantics apply. sample-rate-hz is the authoritative actual samples-per-second value, including high-rate streams. 0 indicates not applicable or not provided.

nominal-frequency-hz.description: Nominal AC frequency in hertz, when applicable.

cycle-aligned.description: Whether delivered frames are aligned to cycle boundaries.

zero-crossing-aligned.description: Whether delivered frames are aligned to a zero-crossing reference.

voltage-scale.description: Scaling factor applied to integer sample formats (int16, int32). This value applies uniformly across voltage channels in the stream. Samples are assumed zero-centered; no offset term is defined in 0.9 metadata. For floating-point formats (float32, float64), this field SHOULD be omitted or set to 1.0.

current-scale.description: Scaling factor applied to integer sample formats (int16, int32). This value applies uniformly across current channels in the stream. Samples are assumed zero-centered; no offset term is defined in 0.9 metadata. For floating-point formats (float32, float64), this field SHOULD be omitted or set to 1.0.

expected-frame-period-ms.description: Expected period between delivered waveform frames in milliseconds.

voltage-filter-lowpass.description: Low-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.

voltage-filter-highpass.description: High-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.

current-filter-lowpass.description: Low-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.

current-filter-highpass.description: High-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.

subscribed.description: Whether the requesting application instance is subscribed after processing this request.

socket-path.description: Runtime AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET socket path for this application instance. Present when the application is subscribed. This field is runtime state for the requesting application instance and is not static discovery metadata.

voltage-channel-count.description: Number of voltage channels present in each sample time step.

current-channel-count.description: Number of current channels present in each sample time step.

other-channel-count.description: Number of additional non-voltage, non-current channels present in each sample time step, if any.

total-channel-count.description: Total number of channels present in each sample time step. This SHALL equal voltage-channel-count plus current-channel-count plus other-channel-count.

sample-rate-hz.description: Sampling rate in hertz for the waveform stream.

samples-per-cycle.description: Discrete sample count per nominal AC cycle, when applicable. For baseline waveform-base streams, this SHALL be at least 128 where AC cycle semantics apply. sample-rate-hz is the authoritative actual samples-per-second value, including high-rate streams. 0 indicates not applicable or not provided.

nominal-frequency-hz.description: Nominal AC frequency in hertz, when applicable.

cycle-aligned.description: Whether delivered frames are aligned to cycle boundaries.

zero-crossing-aligned.description: Whether delivered frames are aligned to a zero-crossing reference.

voltage-scale.description: Scaling factor for voltage channels when integer sample formats are used. This value applies uniformly across voltage channels in the stream. Samples are assumed zero-centered; no offset term is defined in 0.9 metadata. For floating-point formats (float32, float64), this field SHOULD be omitted or set to 1.0.

current-scale.description: Scaling factor for current channels when integer sample formats are used. This value applies uniformly across current channels in the stream. Samples are assumed zero-centered; no offset term is defined in 0.9 metadata. For floating-point formats (float32, float64), this field SHOULD be omitted or set to 1.0.

expected-frame-period-ms.description: Expected period between delivered waveform frames in milliseconds.

voltage-filter-lowpass.description: Low-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.

voltage-filter-highpass.description: High-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.

current-filter-lowpass.description: Low-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.

current-filter-highpass.description: High-pass filter cutoff in hertz if present. Zero or omitted means no filter.
